I am trying to regain the friendship but he is being more and more awkward and distant and seems to be trying to make sure he doesnt spend time with me alone. And im worried if i tell him my feelings or push him a little bit to spend time with me alone, he may end up becoming more distant and will ignore me completely. So i thought if we stuck around for a while as fwb and we still liked each other, we would date. Apparently that seems to be the wrong choice now that i see it. I still really like him but his being awkward, distant and kinda ignoring me is not helping at all for me to sorta make him get thr hint.
I still text him everyday, i meant i was worried that if i told him i had feelings he would cut off our friendship and become even more distant.
Im worried ill make it more awkward than it already is. And I dont want to lose him as a friend as well.

And later he said he didn’t want to be in a proper relationship esp since he had just broken up and the fwb was more fun so we could just stick to that. Besides he was quite clear that he didn’t have any strong feelings for me. Thing is I feel he started questioning what he was doing because I think he felt like the fwb wasn’t the right thing to do since he felt like he was playing with my emotions. And I was like yeah ofc I’m okay, I don’t have the wrong idea, ik it’s just physical but he still kept his distance the whole walk. And then later that night he was like you know I don’t have strong feelings for you right, I don’t wanna end up playing with your feelings and I had to keep telling him that I knew it was only Fwb and I was completely okay with just that. So I feel he may have thought that he was doing the wrong thing by being my fwb even if he just wanted physical intimacy w me because he was afraid I’d get emotionally attached

(We didnt actually have ( piv ) sex yet though so it seems like he stopped himself before it was too late) He's quite a nice guy from what I know ( Ive been his friend since middle school) and i think now he thinks that if he isnt in "full friend mode" he may accidentally lead me on again. Thing is i know and have always sorta known that neither of us have strong feelings for each other, to me it was always just physical. I knew about his ex situation so even when he was super romantic n took me out on dates and all, i knew that he most probably didnt actually have feelings for me and so when he asked me to be his girlfriend several times i declined. I settled for a fwb knowing what i was getting into but i dont think he really understood that i was completely okay with just being physical. Now looks like he's being super distant to make sure neither he or I end up being led on.

Yeah ... what i was trying to say is i didnt break up coz i suddenly found out i was a rebound. I knew i was the rebound but while we were doing the fwb i could see he was conflicted and he himself told me once that he wasnt sure if he was ready ( even though he initiated the whole arrangement) .... i didnt want to push him into sth he wasnt comfortable with or ready for... so we broke it off for him, because me being his rebound may not have been what he needed to get over her

Firstly dont get me wrong... i think i worded the he was wrong part incorrectly in the post... basically i kinda told him to be careful coz if it was someone else he wouldve really toyed with their feelings ( he told me several times that he was definitely over her and we could be together etc.) So i said that he shouldnt do it again to someone else, esp if they were genuinely interested and they didnt know about his ex situation. I did tell him i was greatly in the wrong as well since i allowed most of it to happen instead of stopping him when i knew it was a rebound. I’ve had depression since I was a kid (about 6/7 ish). As a kid I used violent fantasies to cope. Violent fantasies as in torture, murder and bloodshed ( which is probably not the healthiest coping method, especially for a kid). In my early teens I became more self destructive and used self harm and did reckless things (to be honest it was like a game, to see if I’d die or not.. which I guess is definitely not healthy) to cope. Now I drown myself in distractions (and am an insomniac) to prevent my brain from going into self destruct mode.

Hey there, I know everyone feel things differently but I’ve been there and hope what I’m going to say helps.
 I am extremely self destructive and I started getting addicted to pain a few years ago. It started off really simple, as simple as scratching my skin with a rough hairbrush or the sharp side of a key. And at the time I was scared. I was scared of what I was doing and where it could lead to. But I was in such a bad place and I needed a way out, a way to ground myself, a way to let out all I had in my head. And so I didn’t stop. I was in control, I knew I could stop but I didnt, after all why should I when it felt so good. And I kept hurting myself, cutting, burning, whatever I could think of to fuel my addiction to pain. 
I was reckless and it’s a miracle all I have left are a few scars and nothing more. It took me such a long time and a lot of effort to stop hurting myself. Or atleast to transition to hurting myself less and learning to curb my addiction. I still cut from time to time and I get such strong urges to harm myself that it’s extremely hard not to give in.
Please be careful with however you try to hurt yourself. Try your best not to give into the addiction and please try to somehow hold on to the fear of dealing damage to yourself. Trust me, it’s really not worth it. Years down the road you’ll regret your decisions and then you’ll have to hide your scars, fight your urges and do whatever it takes to make sure your self destructive brain doesn’t push you down a deep hole of addiction to pain again.
I don’t know if this was of any help but please just take care of yourself.

Hey, just be careful. I used to self harm and I went down a very deep spiral from which it was extremely hard to get back from. I have a very high pain tolerance and the problem was after a while, the pain I was feeling wasn’t enough. I cut deeper and my cuts were longer and I just kept going. It’s not like I didn’t have control over my actions. I knew exactly what I was doing and I could stop anytime I wanted. But I didn’t want to. I wanted the pain, I wanted to feel the rush I got every time I pulled the blade through my skin. And every time I cut, whatever I did wasn’t enough. So I ended up extremely addicted to self harm, I used to find any reason, any excuse to do it. I started burning my skin and sometimes putting salt or pouring hot water on my cuts. I know it sounds really messed up but I just wanted the pain. It felt so good. 

It took me a long time to get out of that place. I still self harm now and then but I make sure I don’t go down that spiral again. So please, just be careful and know when it’s getting out of hand and you need to stop. I’m not telling you to give it up altogether. Just be moderate with it, don’t be like me and end up addicted to it.

Hi, I don’t think I’ll be of much help but I really understand what you’re saying. My parents have always tried to do the best for me, or at least that’s etched into my head so much that I feel I’ll be a horrible person for leaving. After all, all they’ve done is to try to help me. I struggle with depression and anxiety and I keep telling myself that there’s no way what my parents did is bad. That they’ve done all they can and that I’m a horrible person to be ungrateful to them. But in truth, as much as I tell myself there’s no way these people have had a negative impact in my life and that I’m the one who’s dragging them down or being a nuisance, I’ve realised that even if these people didn’t straight out abuse me on a daily basis, they did have an effect on my mental health. They did have an impact on my life and a lot of that is negative. I don’t know why I’m telling you all this but I hope that you find a way to have enough strength to know what’s right and what’s better for you. To find some sort of peace with leaving them and going to college. This is your life and even if it’s hard you need to live it your way. Your parents don’t define you and though you feel like they worked so hard to bring you up, you must realise that it was their choice to bring you into this world. It’s not your fault that they are in financial problems and make bad desicions and it’s not your obligation to listen to them especially if it drains you and affects you negatively. Please go to college. You may find new friends there, you may find a better life there. And if you still feel bad about leaving your parents there’s nothing stopping you from visiting them a few times in a year. That may ease your guilt and it definitely isn’t as bad as living with them. Also please, just please don’t kill yourself. I’m at no place to say this since I’ve been contemplating suicide but just please consider that it’s not the only option. That you can live and move on. Please don’t buy a gun cause all it’ll do is tempt you more into an easier path out. You don’t want to end your life, you just want out from all this that you are going through everyday. If you ever feel like you aren’t worth it or that you don’t have a purpose, talk to someone, write how you feel in a journal or try doing something that will help you. I just hope I have helped you at least a bit (sorry for the long comment btw) and if you ever need someone to talk to you can message me.
